chunks: And because of their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great calumny.
ai.seo_question: What was the great calumny spoken against Mary in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of the Children of Israel's rejection of divine signs, linking their general disbelief to the specific calumny against Maryam, which served as a precursor to their rejection of her son, Isa. The term 'buhtan' (falsehood/slander) is interpreted not merely as a claim of immorality but as a theological distortion of her pure lineage and status, a point emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to highlight the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt's foremothers. This narrative correction reinforces the legitimacy of Isa's prophethood by validating his mother's chastity against Jewish critiques.
